title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 61 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 61)

content.overview: Following the Mediation Act, 2023 amendments, section 61 now directs that references in other enactments to conciliation under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 are construed as references to mediation under the Mediation Act, 2023. Conciliation terminology in the earlier Part III is therefore not the current operative procedural regime.

content.study:
Section 61 — Reference of conciliation in enactments

Following the Mediation Act, 2023 amendments, section 61 now directs that references in other enactments to conciliation under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 are construed as references to mediation under the Mediation Act, 2023. Conciliation terminology in the earlier Part III is therefore not the current operative procedural regime.

This section must be read with the Mediation Act, 2023 amendments and the statutory saving provision. Counsel must distinguish current mediation law from legacy conciliation proceedings preserved by section 62.
